scope: Real native browser navigation between two loopback servers; mock OAuth only; no real grant or inference

checks.check: Original no-referrer document reproduces native POST Origin null and rejection before OAuth
Actual Continue button submits exact same-origin form and navigates in the same tab
Cross-site provider GET callback without Origin succeeds with session/state and exact redirect binding
OAuth start and callback redirects suppress referrers; callback parameters do not leak to app navigation
Native same-origin submission with an invalid CSRF token fails before creating a connection
Optional provider return in a new window retains the same browser-bound flow; app itself needs no popup

Forged cross-site callback never exchanges a code and reports the invalid state
Opening the exact localhost alias redirects to canonical 127.0.0.1 before session creation, without carrying the query or alias cookies
Native sign-in after canonical navigation keeps Origin, CSRF, browser session and exact callback bound to 127.0.0.1
